title: Replace a media file in a project safely
purpose: Swap one media file for another everywhere it is used in a project without losing the original or breaking playback.
alternateQueries: How do I replace a file in my project?
I have a better version of a recording, how do I swap it in?

entryConditions.description: The user wants to replace media.

steps.title: Confirm which file is being replaced
steps.instruction: Ask the user which media file is being replaced and by what. Repeat both names back.
steps.expectedResult: The user has confirmed the file to replace and the replacement file.

steps.title: Save the project
steps.instruction: Ask the user to save the project, or save it for them if they say yes.
steps.expectedResult: The project has no unsaved changes.

steps.title: Keep a copy of the original
steps.instruction: Import or copy the original file under a new name so it stays in the project.
steps.expectedResult: The original media exists under its backup name.

steps.title: Replace the media
steps.instruction: Swap the replacement file in wherever the original was used, after the user has agreed to exactly that change.
steps.expectedResult: Every clip that used the original now uses the replacement.

steps.title: Check the result
steps.instruction: Play the affected part of the project with the user.
steps.expectedResult: It plays correctly and the user says it is right.

steps.title: Offer to remove the backup
steps.instruction: Ask whether to keep or remove the backup copy. Remove it only if the user says to.
steps.expectedResult: The user has decided about the backup.

completionConditions.description: The media is replaced everywhere and the user has confirmed playback.

recoveryPaths.title: The project would not save
recoveryPaths.trigger: Saving reports an error or the project still shows unsaved changes.
actions: Tell the user the exact error.
Ask them to free space or choose another location, then save again.

recoveryPaths.title: The backup could not be made
recoveryPaths.trigger: The original could not be copied or imported.
actions: Do not continue to the replacement.
Explain that replacing without a backup is not allowed by this process.

recoveryPaths.title: The replacement did not take effect
recoveryPaths.trigger: Some clips still use the original, or playback is wrong.
actions: Offer to restore the backup for those clips.

cancellation.condition: The user says to stop at any point before replace-media completes.
cancellation.effect: Nothing has been changed; the backup copy, if made, stays in the project.

cancellation.condition: The user says to stop after replace-media has completed.
cancellation.effect: Ask whether to restore the backup for the affected clips before ending.
